Tech Mahindra to announce results for second quarter ended 30th September 2026 on 15th October 
2026 
 
 
Pune, India, 2nd October 2026: Tech Mahindra Limited  (NSE: TechM / BSE: 532755), a specialist in AI-
powered technology consulting and digital solutions, will announce its audited results for the second 
quarter ended 30th September 2026 on 15th October 2026. 
The Fact Sheet, Press Release and other supporting documents will be available on Tech Mahindra’s 
website. Following the release, a conference call will be hosted between 6:00-7:00 PM (IST) where Tech 
Mahindra’s management will discuss on the performance for the quarter followed by a Q&A session. 
To participate in the conference call, callers can dial the relevant numbers mentioned in the schedule 
given below in addition to registering and joining via the Diamond Pass to connect to the call directly. A 
replay of the conference call will be available after the call until 22nd October 2026. 
The transcript and audio recording of the conference call will be uploaded on Tech Mahindra’s website.
